attachments.text:
*Describe the bug*

Thank you for fix <https://github.com/vim/vim/issues/8759|vim/vim#8759>.  
I found different case of the issue.  
If the text property is set to before line 400 *and buffer size is greater than 520* , the result of line2byte() after line 400 will be an wrong value.

*To Reproduce*

sample.vim

```
:call setline(1,range(520))
:echom "before" line2byte(401)
:call prop_type_add('vim-test',{})
:call prop_add(2,1,{'type': 'vim-test'})
:echom "after" line2byte(401)
```

1. `vim -u NONE`
2. `:source sample.vim`

the script result

```
before 1491
after 1511

```

*Expected behavior*

`:echom "before" line2byte(401)` and `:echom "after" line2byte(401)` show same line2byte value.

*Environment (please complete the following information):*

• Vim version [8.2.3350]
• OS: macOS 10.15.7
• Terminal: Alacritty

attachments.text:
*Describe the bug*  
When pressing `<Tab>` to complete function name, user-functions (starting with uppercase character) does not show.

*To Reproduce*  
Detailed steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. create a temporary directory as `vimfiles` (I will call it `~/vim-2` below);
2. In this directory, create a empty file (`touch empty.vim` on unix like system); create another file `file-2.vim` with the following content:

```
" define a dict function.
function! s:hahaha() dict
endfunction
```

3. cd to vim source code directory (I will call it `~/repos/vim` below), and build a vim binary (generate `src/vim`);
4. create a temporary vimrc: `tmp.vimrc`, with the following content:

```
set nocp

function! Date()
endfunction

set rtp=~/vim-2,~/repos/vim/runtime

" source order matters
source ~/vim-2/empty.vim
source ~/vim-2/file-2.vim

" this is required
let g:loaded_logiPat = 1
```

5. launch vim with: `./src/vim -u tmp.vimrc`;
6. In command line mode, press `call D<Tab>` to trigger completion.

*Expected behavior*  
`Date` (as we defined in step 4) should be put in cmd line.

*Screenshots*  
none.

*Environment (please complete the following information):*

• Vim version since v8.2.3337
• OS: tested in Alpine Linux 3.14, macOS 11.5.2
• Terminal: tmux inside alacritty

*Additional context*  
I use `git bisect` to figure out that v8.2.3337 (069f90852f1444cac50491c10dfbd339a3f9e0c8) introduces this bug.

It is rather strange to run these steps. But it is the cleanest environment I have found that will trigger the bug right now.
